svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 12/12 Valley Stars (Common)
svg.desc: Out past the last streetlight it gets properly dark. The crickets keep going until morning. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
